name: Gingerols
summary: Gingerols are ginger phenolic constituents linked to pain/inflammation effects, with human evidence mostly through standardized ginger extracts rather than isolated gingerol dosing.
description: Gingerols are tracked for COX-2/PGE2 pathway modulation relevant to osteoarthritis pain physiology, with standardized-extract human trial signals but variable strength.
safetyNotes: Human pregnancy and lactation evidence concerns oral ginger preparations rather than isolated gingerols. Constituent-specific dose-response, bleeding, blood-pressure, blood-sugar, surgery, liver, kidney, and medication-interaction safety remains insufficient and should not be inferred from whole ginger.
